operation: Existing Show editor on the v2 backing at 1440x900 with reduced motion, fresh Installation Shows seeded through /api/shows and stored as v2. Capture 1: a Show with two Clips on one Layer and no Transition (TestPattern1D 0-30 s, CometLoom 30-60 s, layer:zone-1:main); CometLoom is dragged and dropped a quarter of the way in, over TestPattern1D. The clip-temporal owner refuses the overlap, CometLoom shows the red 'Space taken' label, and the timeline role=status reads 'Clips on one Layer cannot overlap.'. 1.5 s later the stored v2 record is unchanged: updatedAt 1790220129957 before and after, both Clips at the same start, duration and Layer. Capture 2 (Show 26193495-486e-4c61-b58e-efc4acfe4ac4): the default Installation Show with its converted crossfade Transition (30000-31999 ms), plus a second empty Layer added through Add > Layer because the Transition's own control covers its Layer. A double-click on that Layer at 31000 ms refuses the add: the timeline role=status reads 'A Clip cannot start inside a Transition.', no Clip label appears, no add dialog opens, and the stored record's updatedAt is unchanged. That status line is screen-reader only; the proof script removed its sr-only class for the capture alone and drew it bottom-left.
